title: Agentic Discovery of Soundness Bugs in Safe Rust Bindings
abstract: arXiv:2611.31813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rust crates confine unsafe code, such as calls into C or C++ libraries or system calls, behind safe interfaces that must uphold Rust's invariants. If an interface encodes one rule of the code beneath it too weakly, a program written in purely safe Rust can cause undefined behavior. Static analyzers and fuzzers are bound to fixed patterns or to the paths they execute. We propose LLM agents as auditors of these interfaces, and study how well they do it.   We first define a taxonomy of the defects of such interfaces, including undefined behavior, divergences from the wrapped library, and incomplete unsafe contracts. We then measure, in repeated audits of a real-world crate by a closed and an open model, Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, which defect classes agents find, how well they triage them, and what makes them find more. translated_title: 基于智能体的安全Rust绑定健全性漏洞发现
translated_abstract: Rust crate 将不安全代码（例如对 C 或 C++ 库的调用、系统调用）封装在必须维护 Rust 不变量的安全接口之后。如果接口对其底层代码的某条规则约束得过于宽松，用纯安全 Rust 编写的程序就可能引发未定义行为。静态分析器和模糊测试工具受限于固定的模式或其实际执行的路径。我们提出将 LLM 智能体用作这些接口的审计员，并研究其审计效果。我们首先为此类接口的缺陷定义了一个分类体系，包括未定义行为、与被封装库的偏差，以及不完整的不安全契约。随后，我们通过闭源模型 Claude Opus 5.5 和开源模型 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 对一个真实世界 crate 进行重复审计，测量了智能体能发现哪些类别的缺陷、它们的缺陷分类能力如何，以及哪些因素能促使它们发现更多缺陷。结果表明，智能体在无提示的情况下就能发现前两类缺陷，但即使在明确要求下也很少发现不完整的不安全契约。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将LLM智能体作为Rust安全封装接口的审计员来发现健全性漏洞，定义了此类接口缺陷的分类体系，并通过真实crate的重复审计实验发现：智能体能自发找到未定义行为和与底层库的偏差，却难以发现不完整的不安全契约。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using LLM agents as auditors of safe Rust interfaces to discover soundness bugs, defines a taxonomy of such interface defects, and shows through repeated audits of a real-world crate that agents can spontaneously find undefined behavior and divergences from the wrapped library, but struggle to identify incomplete unsafe contracts.
